title: Automated batching & caching advisor with RBAC-backed safe apply/rollback and immutable audit logs
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a safe, auditable automation flow that turns model-serving workload telemetry into batching and caching configuration recommendations and can optionally auto-apply them with strict RBAC and change-management controls. The feature is split into two capabilities: 1) a read-only advisor that analyzes request patterns, KV cache hit distributions, sequence length percentiles and returns suggested batch sizes, burst window settings, and cache TTL/prefix rules with estimated cost and latency impact; 2) an autopilot path that can materialize those recommendations into live config changes on dedicated/private clusters but only when guardrails (RBAC approvals, canary windows, rollback triggers) are satisfied. Auditability must be tamper-evident and meet enterprise compliance expectations (append-only ledger, KMS-signed attestations, and per-change metadata).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Advisor endpoint returns per-route recommendations with expected cost delta and 90/95/99th latency estimates for synthetic and historical workloads.
2) Only users/roles in the documented RBAC policy can schedule an autopilot apply (automation service principal + reviewer roles).
3) Autopilot supports canary rollout to a subset of hosts or customer routes, observes defined SLOs for 10 minutes, and either continues or rolls back automatically on regressions.
4) Every proposed change generates an immutable audit record (signed, timestamped) with the diff, actor, approver, timeline, and metrics snapshot.
5) Audit logs are queryable from Console for 1 year; exportable to external SIEM.
6) E2E tests simulate regression signals and validate automated rollback path.
7) Documentation and runbook for operations and security are published.
implementation_notes:
- New service: cost-advisor (Go) that consumes telemetry (ingest from metrics pipeline), runs heuristics + ML-lite estimator for batching/caching.
- Recommendation format: JSON diff for Config API (batch_size, max_batch_delay_ms, cache_ttl_ms, cache_prefix_rules, batching_mode).
- Autopilot controller integrates with control-plane Config API and a new change-manager component that enforces RBAC, schedules windows, and orchestrates canary traffic.
- RBAC: extend existing IAM roles with two new bindings: cost_advisor_executor (service principal) and cost_change_reviewer (human approver). Use short-lived attestations for automation tokens.
- Audit: append-only ledger implemented by write-once records to object-store + KMS-signed digest stored in audit-index (supports tamper-evidence). Hook into existing audit-log ingestion for SIEM.
- Rollback triggers: >5% P95 latency increase OR >3% error-rate delta OR explicit negative quality signal from eval pipeline within canary window.
- Telemetry hooks: trace IDs for each apply, per-token latency breakdown, token-cost estimate recorded.
- Policy engine: OPA to express whitelists (models/routes allowed to be auto-applied) and blackout windows.
- DB: small metadata store (Postgres) for proposals and state machine (proposed -> scheduled -> canary -> promoted/rolled_back).
rollout_plan:
1) Alpha: advisor-only mode available to internal infra teams (no autopilot apply) for 2 weeks.
2) Beta: enable autopilot for non-production clusters with manual approval required for each apply. Runbook and SLO alerts active.
3) Canary: allow autopilot automatic canary for a single team with tight thresholds.
4) Gradual: expand autopilot to more clusters and routes after sign-offs.
5) Enterprise: provide opt-in audit-retention and KMS attestation options for customers.
Links: Confluence proposal, GH PRs and dashboards are in the links section.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for advisor heuristics and estimator accuracy on synthetic corpora.
- Integration tests: proposed JSON diffs applied to a staging control-plane; validate expected resource behavior (batching throughput, cache hits).
- Chaos tests: inject latency/error to ensure rollback triggers fire.
- Security tests: verify RBAC enforcement, token rotation and attestation validation.
- Compliance tests: verify audit records are signed and cannot be altered; SIEM ingestion simulation.
- Performance tests: ensure advisor runs in <5s for 1k routes and does not overload metrics pipeline.
monitoring_and_alerting:
- Dashboard: advisor-recommendation-rate, false-positive rate (ops decline), autopilot-applies, rollback-rate, apply-latency.
- Alerts: autopilot-rollback-rate > 1% over 1h, apply-failure-rate > 0.5% in 15m, missing audit-entries, KMS signing failures.
- Tracing: every apply is traceable end-to-end (recommendation -> apply -> canary observation -> outcome).
risk_mitigation:
- Start advisor in read-only mode to gather feedback before enabling autopilot.
- Conservative defaults: small batch multipliers and short cache TTLs until signals prove safe.
- Human-in-the-loop for initial rollout; require cost_change_reviewer approval for high-impact routes.
- Rehearsal tests in staging with synthetic traffic to ensure rollbacks are reliable.
- Clear rollback playbook and on-call rotation during rollout windows.
